Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.bengalchemicals.co.in. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bengal Chemicals Quality Assurance Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Quality Assurance Officer post is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Quality Assurance Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B. Pharm., M.Pharm., or M.Sc. (Chemistry) degree to be eligible for the Quality Assurance Officer role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the experience required for this post?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or Manufacturing of a pharmaceutical formulation unit is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Quality Assurance Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Quality Assurance Officer position is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to send the duly filled application form along with self-attested copies of testimonials to the Sr. Manager (HR & Admin.) at the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this job?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Quality Assurance Officer role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is a consolidated pay, which will depend on the candidate's qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is PER/0106/2026-2027/3.

faq.question: Q10. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. (A Govt. Of India Enterprise).
